purpose: Define alternate recovery environments/sites as explicit identities with exact capacity, data replication, secrets, listener and governance boundaries.

topics.name: Recovery Site Identity
topics.purpose: Define alternate recovery environments/sites as explicit identities with exact capacity, data replication, secrets, listener and governance boundaries.

semantics.identity_rule: Each recovery site/environment has explicit identity.
semantics.data_rule: Replicated/available data scopes and lag are explicit.
semantics.governance_rule: IAM/AccessCore/governance remain active in recovery site.
semantics.authority_rule: Recovery-site availability grants no failover authority.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: same hostname means same environment identity

references.purpose: Recovery site is an explicit deployment environment class.
